svg.title: S-CORE Lifecycle | Type Model (Process / Recovery / Health Monitor)

g.text: S-CORE Lifecycle | Type Model (Process / Recovery / Health Monitor)
DISTINCT config structs in two DIFFERENT optional
slots -- not a tagged union / single enum.
Only one slot is populated per component config.

pid is exposed via getPid(). exit_code and process_execution_error are NOT exposed via getters on this class; process_group_id and recovery_state are exposed on HealthMonitorState, not this class. All four are only observable via the external monitor notification callback (comp_req_launch_man_ext_monitor_notify). The supervision fields (supervision_status, failed_supervision_type, etc.) are likewise observable via that callback, not via getters on this class.

HealthMonitorState is populated by the external monitor notification callback. Its fields (except process_group_id and recovery_state, which are also callback-only) are supervision-related and mapped into score-lifecycle-state RawEvidenceSchema: supervision_status, failed_supervision_type, deadline_error, heartbeat_error, logic_error, deadline_violation, failed_supervision_cycles, alive_indication_count, process_execution_error, process_group_id, recovery_state.
